_comment: SHA-256 pins for the ffmpeg/ffprobe sidecars fetched by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs, keyed by <name>-<rust host triple>. This is the SECOND pin layer: the script already hard-pins the SHA-256 of every downloaded ARCHIVE, so these cover the exact unpacked bytes that get bundled and shipped. A mismatch hard-fails the fetch; a missing key logs the computed hash with pin instructions. Copied from SundayRec's file for ffmpeg 8.1.2 — same archives, same publishers, so the same bytes are expected; the mac arm64 pins were re-verified on the owner's machine during SundaySync E1 (2026-08-08). macOS Intel is unpinned because nothing builds it yet.
